text:
Type: ombre wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: woven wool, fine ribbed texture
Colors: charcoal grey fading to warm beige
Shape: large rectangle, smooth horizontal gradient from light to dark, flat low pile, clean edges, substantial
Feel: calm, grounded, sophisticated
Goes with: grey upholstery, dark wood, natural baskets; modern or minimalist rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Ombre Wool Rug, 7'6" x 9'6", Charcoal
product.description: Pile: 100% Wool, Backing: 100% Canvas Imported Deep and light hues fade into each other in this ombré pattern rug. Subtle yet striking, this 100% wool rug is high on style and softness. Area rug features an ombré pattern Hand-tufted with 100% wool fibers Plush .65'' pile suits high-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 7'6" x 9'6" Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle
